description.message: Cleans the sites and words you choose out of your history, while you browse, when you close the browser, or at the next start.

layoutTitle.message: Switch between the small popup and the classic one

optSub.message: Tell it what to forget. Your rules follow you to your other computers, everything else stays on this one.

optLockedBody.message: Your list is hidden until you unlock it below. Cleaning carries on.

optModeRealtimeHint.message: It cleans as you go, so nothing is ever left waiting around.

optModeOnCloseHint.message: Quiet while you surf. It cleans when you close the browser, or the next time you open it if that moment is missed.

optModeStartupHint.message: One clean up each time you open the browser.

optSweep.message: Also clean history that is already saved, at browser start

optNotify.message: Tell me when it has cleaned

optKeepLog.message: Keep a list of what was cleaned

optListHint.message: Anything on this list is cleaned. Sites, words, or address beginnings, whichever suits you.

optKeepOnly.message: Keep only the sites on my list, clean everything else

optTypeKeyword.message: Word in the address or title

optRulesEmpty.message: Nothing on the list yet. Add a site or a word above.

optTryUrl.message: Check an address against the list

optClearingHint.message: Pick a level. History is always cleaned, these are the extras.

optPresetOffSub.message: My history only, following my rules.

optPresetLightSub.message: History, plus the saved page files that make sites open fast.

optPresetStandardSub.message: The same, plus cookies, which is what makes sites remember you.

optPresetNuclearSub.message: Everything Chrome lets a cleaner touch, all history included. Passwords are never touched.

optClearingNote.message: Chrome does not say how much it cleared, so there is no number to show. Clearing cookies signs you out of that site. Downloads means the list, not your files. Passwords are not included, Chrome took that away in version 144.

optCookiesOnTabClose.message: Clear a site's cookies when I close its tab

optCookieKeepLabel.message: Stay logged in on these sites, one per line

optLockEnable.message: Hide the list behind a PIN

optLockRecoverBtn.message: Remove the PIN and wipe my list

optLockNote.message: You need the PIN to turn this off as well. While it is on, the right-click menu that adds a site only shows a notification.

optAdvancedHint.message: Cookies, the address tester, import and export, the switch that ignores your list.

optWipeAll.message: Clean all history, not just what is on my list

optWipeAllHint.message: Your list stops mattering: every trigger clears the whole history. The list stays where it is and counts again the moment this is off.

optLimitsBanner.message: Two things Chrome will not let a cleaner do. It cannot run at the exact moment the browser closes, so if that moment is missed the clean happens the next time you open it. And an address you deleted can still show up in the address bar suggestions.

statusKeep.message: Wiping all but your keep list

wipeAllOn.message: Wipe-all is ON: your whole history goes, not just your rules.

keepOn.message: Everything not on your list is wiped.

modeInstantArmed.message: Every visit is erased the moment it happens.

modeClose.message: Matches go when you close the browser.

modeCloseArmed.message: Everything goes when you close the browser.

modeStart.message: Matches go at the start of your next session.

modeStartArmed.message: Everything goes at the start of your next session.

keepInstant.message: Every other site is erased as you visit it.

keepClose.message: Everything else goes when you close the browser.

keepStart.message: Everything else goes at your next start.

stateKeep.message: Active: wiping all but your keep list

ruleKeyword.message: Word in the address or title
